papers.title: Understanding Charge Acceptance Limitations During Extreme Fast‐Charging of Li‐ion Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Extreme fast charging in lithium‐ion batteries is limited by their poor charge acceptance at high C‐rates. We use overpotential component analysis to decouple ohmic, kinetic and transport voltage losses during fast charging. The concentration gradients are identified as the primary culprit in poor charge acceptance, so we study carbonate electrolytes that utilize acetonitrile, a low viscosity, high dielectric liquid, as a co‐solvent to improve ion transport. Our results indicate acetonitrile co‐solvent successfully reduces fast charging concentration gradients and therefore improves charge acceptance at high C‐rates, particularly when used in combination with interface‐stabilizing additives. Molecular dynamics simulations show that ACN enhances Li + transport through a combination of reduced bulk viscosity and increased solvation‐shell lability, with shorter solvent residence times and faster coordination exchange producing transport gains beyond those expected from viscosity reduction alone. Finally, we use three‐electrode cells to deconvolute overpotential at each electrode, and the specific LiNi 0.8 Mn 0.1 Co 0.1 O 2 (NMC811) electrode architecture and loading used in our study is found to have much higher overpotentials than our graphite electrode. In particular, the significant differences in NMC811 concentration gradients between electrolytes with or without acetonitrile indicate that the design of electrode architecture is crucial for extreme fast charging applications.

papers.title: Catalytic Interphases Enable Sulfur Redox Catalysis in All-Solid-State Lithium–Sulfur Batteries
papers.venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society
papers.abstract_en: Abstract Weak solid–solid contact with limited chemical and transport continuity is a common bottleneck in solid-state batteries, particularly in all-solid-state lithium–sulfur batteries (ASSLSBs), where Li2S/S8 conversion requires catalytic acceleration but lacks a continuous solid-state catalytic pathway. Here, we propose an interphase catalysis strategy for solid–solid sulfur conversion by transforming discrete catalyst/reactant interfaces into a chemically integrated reaction interphase. WO3 is identified as a suitable oxide to construct such a metastable mixed-anion S–W–O catalytic interphase on Li2S based on the work-function difference between the metal oxide catalyst and Li2S/S8, which serves as a practical screening rationale for evaluating the relative tendency toward sulfur–oxygen coordination exchange. The interphase contains unsaturated W centers and a polarized electronic environment, enabling coupled electron/Li+ transport and dynamically regulating sulfur redox through coupled sulfur-species exchange. This integrated interphase further stabilizes cathode interfaces during repeated Li2S/S8 conversion. As a result, the optimized cathode sustains stable cycling over 15000 cycles at 10 C and a temperature of 60 °C. A record-high Li2S loading of 30 mg cm–2 with an areal capacity of 21.2 mAh cm–2 is also achieved, demonstrating interphase catalysis as an effective route to overcome solid-state sulfur-conversion limitations in practical ASSLSBs.
papers.summary_ko: 전고체 리튬-황 전지에서 고체-고체 접촉 불량으로 Li2S/S8 전환 반응의 촉매 경로가 단절되는 문제를 해결하기 위해 계면 촉매(interphase catalysis) 전략을 제안했다. WO3와 Li2S 사이의 일함수 차이를 이용해 S-W-O 혼합 음이온 계면을 형성시켜 불포화 W 중심과 분극된 전자 환경을 통해 전자/Li+ 수송을 결합시키고 황 레독스를 동적으로 조절한다. 이를 통해 10C, 60°C 조건에서 15000회 이상의 안정적 사이클과 30 mg cm-2의 높은 Li2S 로딩, 21.2 mAh cm-2의 면적 용량을 달성했다.

papers.title: Ultra‐High Ionic Conductivity Sulfide‐Based Composite Membranes Paired With Stable Interfacial Layer Enables High‐Energy‐Density All‐Solid‐State Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Intrinsic properties of sulfide solid‐state electrolytes (SEs) are crucial for achieving all‐solid‐state batteries (ASSBs) with high safety and high energy density, yet it is challenging to fabricate high‐performance sulfide SE films in a scalable approach. Furthermore, the inevitable side reactions between sulfide SE and lithium metal anodes exacerbate interfacial incompatibility, causing degradation in the cyclic stability. Here, a high‐performance sulfide SE (Li 5.4 PS 4.4 Cl 0.8 Br 0.8 ) was selected as the base phase to compensate for the loss of electrochemical performance during the dry film‐forming process. It was then combined with Polytetrafluoroethylene binder to prepare a high‐ionic‐conductivity composite membrane (HICCM). To mitigate side reactions between HICCM and the anode, a LiF‐rich interfacial layer forms in situ on the lithium metal surface, and the assembled symmetric cell achieves a high critical current density of 1.3 mA cm −2 and stable cycling for 2000 h (0.2 mA cm −2 ). For electrochemical performance, HICCM exhibits fast ion transport kinetics and electrical insulation, allowing the ASSB configured as FeS 2 //HICCM//LiF‐Li to achieve an energy density of 416.5 Wh kg −1 at a high loading of 3.4 mAh cm −2 . This work demonstrates that by combining HICCM with a stable interface design, ASSBs can achieve longevity and high cell‐level energy density.
papers.summary_ko: 황화물 고체전해질 기반 복합 멤브레인(HICCM)을 PTFE 바인더와 결합하여 고이온전도성 필름을 제작했다. 리튬 금속 표면에 LiF가 풍부한 계면층을 형성시켜 부반응을 억제함으로써 1.3 mA cm⁻²의 임계전류밀도와 2000시간 안정적 사이클링(0.2 mA cm⁻²)을 달성했다. FeS2//HICCM//LiF-Li 전고체전지는 3.4 mAh cm⁻² 고로딩에서 416.5 Wh kg⁻¹의 에너지밀도를 구현했다.

papers.title: Regioisomeric Engineering of Pyridone Electrolyte Additives Enables Stably High‐Voltage LiCoO 2 Cathodes Lithium‐Ion Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Achieving high‐energy‐density lithium‐ion batteries (LIBs) requires deep delithiation of layered oxides, yet operating LiCoO 2 (LCO) above 4.55 V triggers Co‐O electronic instability and accelerates electrolyte degradation. Electrolyte additives can passivate this interface, yet which molecular features control surface coordination and interphase chemistry remains unclear. Here we show that the regioisomeric substitution pattern of pyridone additives couples surface coordination to protective interphase formation, producing distinct stabilization mechanisms. Among the isomers, the para‐isomer 5‐fluoro‐2‐hydroxy‐3‐nitropyridine (p‐HNFP) yields the most effective stabilization. Spectroscopic and computational analyses indicate that p‐HNFP adsorbs preferentially on the delithiated LCO surface through σ‐type lone‐pair donation from the pyridone carbonyl oxygen to electron‐deficient Co 4+ centers, lowering the O 2p band center and widening the Co 3d‐O 2p gap, consistent with a reduced thermodynamic driving force for lattice‐oxygen oxidation. This interaction operates in tandem with a compact, LiF‐ and nitrogen‐enriched cathode‐electrolyte interphase (CEI) formed by regioselective oxidative decomposition of p‐HNFP, suppressing dehydrogenation‐initiated carbonate decomposition and preserving LCO structural integrity. Consequently, 1 wt% p‐HNFP enables fast‐charging 2 Ah Gr||LCO pouch cells (2.46 mAh cm −2 ) to retain 92.4% capacity after 400 cycles at 4.6 V. These findings establish regioisomeric engineering as a molecular design strategy for stabilizing high‐voltage LiCoO 2 interphases in LIBs.
papers.summary_ko: LiCoO2(LCO) 고전압 작동 시 Co-O 전자구조 불안정과 전해질 분해를 억제하기 위해 피리돈계 전해질 첨가제의 위치이성질체 구조를 제어했다. para 이성질체인 p-HNFP가 탈리튬화된 LCO 표면의 Co4+ 중심에 선택적으로 흡착하여 O 2p 밴드를 낮추고 LiF·질소가 풍부한 CEI를 형성함을 분광 및 계산화학으로 확인했다. 1 wt% 첨가 시 4.6V, 2Ah Gr||LCO 파우치셀이 400회 사이클 후 92.4%의 용량을 유지했다.

papers.title: Nanofluid wetting of Cu enables thin lithium negative electrodes for high-energy and long-cycling lithium metal batteries
papers.abstract_en: Abstract Exploiting thin Li foils ≤ 20 μm is required for high-energy-density and long-cycling-lifespan battery, but is severely hindered by the poor processability of Li, as well as its inhomogeneous plating behaviors and resulting low Coulombic efficiency. Herein, an approach balancing Li supply and consumption is fulfilled by designing thin molten-salt-derived, nanocomposite Li@LiX metal negative electrodes. Benefitting from the formation of nanofluid due to the spontaneous reaction of inorganic nanoparticles in molten Li, the bonding states at both Li surface and Li|Cu interface are effectively regulated, displaying an enhanced wetting behaviour of Li on Cu. This approach enables the fabrication of an 800-nm-thick Li-based negative electrode foil as well as the formation of an inorganic-rich interphase upon cycling, which suppresses Li consumption by reducing corrosion susceptibility. As a result, practical pouch cells composed of 10-μm-thick Li@lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide (LiFSI) and LiFePO 4 offer stable cycling over 250 cycles, while those composed of 20-μm-thick Li@LiFSI and LiNi 0.92 Co 0.03 Mn 0.05 O 2 with an areal capacity of 4.6 mAh cm −2 achieve 100 cycles, yielding specific energy of 498 Wh kg −1 and energy density of 1,142 Wh L −1 , indicating that this design strategy is applicable to lithium metal batteries.
papers.summary_ko: 용융염 유래 나노복합 Li@LiX 음극에서 무기 나노입자의 자발 반응으로 형성된 나노유체를 이용해 Li 표면 및 Li|Cu 계면의 결합 상태를 조절, Cu 집전체 위 Li의 젖음성을 향상시켰다. 이를 통해 두께 800nm의 얇은 Li 음극 포일을 제작하고 사이클 중 무기물 풍부 계면을 형성하여 부식에 의한 Li 소모를 줄였다. 10μm Li@LiFSI/LFP 파우치셀은 250회, 20μm Li@LiFSI/NCM(Ni 0.92) 파우치셀은 100회 안정적으로 작동하며 각각 498 Wh kg⁻¹, 1142 Wh L⁻¹의 에너지밀도를 달성했다.

papers.title: High‐Entropy Sulfides Enable Dual‐Pathway Sulfur Conversion in PEO‐Based All‐Solid‐State Li–S Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT All‐solid‐state lithium‐sulfur batteries (ASSLSBs) are promising for safe, high‐energy storage, but their development is limited by lithium polysulfides (LiPSs) dissolution and shuttle effect in poly(ethylene oxide)‐based solid polymer electrolytes, leading to sluggish sulfur conversion and rapid capacity decay. Herein, we report a dual‐phase high‐entropy sulfide system (HES, FeCoNiCuMoS x ) nanoflowers as a multifunctional sulfur host. Owing to lattice distortion and strong d‐p orbital coupling, HES exhibits strong chemical affinity toward LiPSs and accelerates sulfur conversion. Importantly, the dual‐phase HES enables a dual‐pathway sulfur reduction reaction, in which a restrained LiPSs‐mediated “liquid”‐phase route sustains kinetics, while a dominant “solid‐solid” (S to Li 2 S) pathway fundamentally blocks LiPSs dissolution and shuttling. As a result, the S@HES cathode delivers a high specific capacity of 1319.3 mAh g −1 at 0.1 C and maintains remarkable cycling stability with a low capacity decay rate of only 0.0458% per cycle over 1000 cycles at 1 C, along with stable electrochemical performance over the investigated temperature range of 40°C to 60°C. Furthermore, S@HES‐based pouch cells exhibit excellent mechanical flexibility and deliver a high initial capacity of 1365.8 mAh g − 1 with stable cycling performance, collectively underscoring the strong potential of this dual‐pathway regulation strategy for practical advanced ASSLSBs.
papers.summary_ko: PEO 기반 전고체 리튬-황 전지에서 리튬 폴리설파이드 용해와 셔틀 효과를 억제하기 위해 이중상 고엔트로피 황화물(FeCoNiCuMoSx) 나노플라워를 다기능 황 호스트로 제안했다. 격자 왜곡과 강한 d-p 오비탈 결합으로 폴리설파이드에 대한 화학적 친화력을 높이고, 액상 경로를 억제하면서 고체-고체(S to Li2S) 전환 경로를 지배적으로 만들어 셔틀 효과를 근본적으로 차단한다. S@HES 캐소드는 0.1C에서 1319.3 mAh g-1의 용량과 1C/1000사이클에서 0.0458%/사이클의 낮은 용량 감쇠율을 보였으며, 파우치셀에서도 우수한 유연성과 안정적 사이클 성능을 나타냈다.

papers.title: Grape Cluster Inspired Biomimetic Composite Solid Electrolyte for High‐Voltage and Long‐Life Solid‐State Lithium Metal Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Solid‐state lithium metal batteries suffer from poor interfacial stability and dendrite growth, primarily limited by the ion transport kinetics and mechanical properties of composite solid electrolytes (CSE). Inspired by the hierarchical grape cluster, we design a biomimetic electrolyte via electrospinning PAN fiber “pedicel” integrated with mesoporous SiO 2 ‐SO 3 Li “grape berry” fillers, followed by in‐situ polymerization. This structure establishes long‐range Li + conduction channels and a robust physical barrier, delivering a high Li + transference number of 0.65, ionic conductivity of 1.44 × 10 −3 S cm −1 at 25°C, and a modulus of 520 MPa. Benefiting from these advantages, the assembled LFP|Li and NCM811|Li cells achieve 88.8% capacity retention after 1000 cycles and 94.3% after 300 cycles, respectively. Moreover, a high‐loading pouch cell realizes an energy density of 414.9 Wh kg −1 /797.8 Wh L −1 and withstands harsh abuse tests. Mechanistically, DFT and phase‐field simulations reveal the dual Li + pathways and TFSI − immobilization enabled by the ‐SO 3 Li groups. Notably, a physics‐informed neural network (PINN) framework decouples interface activation‐aging kinetics and predicts long‐term impedance evolution. This work provides a biomimetic paradigm and data‐driven methods for the design and interface analysis of high‐performance CSE.

DFT 및 상장(phase-field) 시뮬레이션으로 이중 Li+ 경로와 TFSI⁻ 고정 메커니즘을 규명하고, 물리 정보 신경망(PINN)으로 계면 노화 거동을 예측했다.

papers.title: Coupling electrolyte mechanical reinforcement and interfacial stress relaxation for near-ambient sulfide all-solid-state lithium metal batteries
papers.abstract_en: All-solid-state lithium metal batteries offer the promise of higher energy density and improved safety compared with conventional lithium-ion batteries; however, their practical operation at room temperature and low stack pressures ( ~ 0.1 MPa) remains challenging due to lithium dendrite formation and stress-induced interfacial degradation. Herein, we demonstrate near-ambient operation ( ≤ 0.3 MPa, room temperature) of all-solid-state lithium metal batteries through a combined electrolyte–current collector design. A self-polymerizable thioctic acid-modified composite solid electrolyte suppresses internal lithium metal creep with high stress tolerance, while a porous carbon matrix current collector provides localized stress relaxation and accommodates lithium deposition within internal voids. As a result, stable long-term cycling is achieved under near-ambient conditions even at a high areal loading of 2.4 mAh cm−2 using a LiNi0.8Co0.1Mn0.1O2 positive electrode operated at 0.1 C. These findings highlight the importance of controlling lithium deformation and stress relaxation for the development of practical all-solid-state lithium metal batteries. All-solid-state lithium metal batteries can suffer from dendrite growth and interfacial stress at low pressures. Here, authors couple a self-polymerizable composite sulfide electrolyte with a porous carbon current collector, enabling stable near-ambient condition cycling at high areal loading.
papers.summary_ko: 자가중합형 티옥트산 변성 복합 고체전해질과 다공성 탄소 집전체를 결합해, 상온·저압(≤0.3 MPa)에서도 안정적으로 작동하는 황화물계 전고체 리튬금속전지를 구현했다. 복합 전해질은 Li 금속의 크리프를 억제하고 높은 응력 내성을 가지며, 다공성 탄소 집전체는 국부 응력을 완화하고 내부 공극에 Li 증착을 유도한다. NCM811 양극, 2.4 mAh cm⁻² 고로딩, 0.1C 조건에서 장기 안정 사이클링을 확인했다.

papers.title: Beyond Superlattice Order: Full‐Composition Li Stoichiometry Screening Identifies Interfacial Spinel Passivation as the Decisive Factor for Durable Cobalt‐Free Li‐Rich Cathodes
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Cobalt‐free Li‐rich layered oxides (LRMs) hold great promise for next‐generation high‐energy batteries, yet their practical deployment is severely hindered by irreversible oxygen redox and progressive interfacial degradation. Here, a full‐range Li stoichiometry screening across Li 1+0.65 x Ni 0.35 Mn 0.65 O 2+0.65 x (0 ≤ x ≤ 1) was conducted to decouple bulk superlattice evolution from surface chemistry. A structural crossover at x ≈ 0.5 with minimized Li 2 MnO 3 long‐range ordering is identified, yet optimal electrochemistry unexpectedly emerges at x = 0.375, governed by a triple synergistic mechanism: finely dispersed Li 2 MnO 3 nanodomains, moderate Li + /Ni 2+ antisite pillars, and—most critically— an in situ coherent spinel passivation interphase spontaneously formed during calcination. The optimized LRM0.375 delivers 227.1 mAh g −1 at 0.1C, 161.8 mAh g −1 at 5C, and an ultralow voltage fade of only 1.33 mV cycle −1 , with its graphite full cell retaining 78.48% capacity after 500 cycles. Operando XRD, RIXS, and DEMS collectively demonstrate that the spinel surface barrier, rather than bulk superlattice ordering alone, governs anionic redox reversibility and cycling durability. This work challenges the superlattice‐centered design paradigm and identifies interfacial spinel passivation as a key stability‐governing factor within a triple synergistic mechanism, providing targeted stoichiometric guidelines for designing durable anionic‐redox cathodes beyond conventional bulk‐structure‐focused strategies.
papers.summary_ko: 코발트-프리 Li-rich 층상산화물 Li1+0.65x Ni0.35Mn0.65O2+0.65x(0≤x≤1)의 전체 조성 범위에서 Li 화학양론을 스크리닝하여 벌크 초격자 구조와 표면화학을 분리 분석했다. x≈0.5에서 Li2MnO3 장거리 질서가 최소화되는 구조적 교차점이 나타나지만, 실제 최적 전기화학 성능은 x=0.375에서 미세분산 Li2MnO3 나노도메인, Li+/Ni2+ 안티사이트, 소성 중 자발적으로 형성되는 스피넬 계면상의 삼중 상승효과로 구현됨을 밝혔다. 최적화된 LRM0.375는 0.1C에서 227.1 mAh g⁻¹, 5C에서 161.8 mAh g⁻¹, 사이클당 전압감쇠 1.33 mV의 특성을 보였고, 흑연 완전셀에서 500회 후 78.48%의 용량을 유지했다.

papers.title: Anchoring LiZn Nanocrystals With Oligomer Binders for Enhanced Interfacial Stability in Lithium Metal Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Lithium (Li) metal batteries have emerged as one of the most promising candidates for next‐generation energy storage systems due to the potentially high energy density. Nevertheless, repeated interfacial breakdown causes a short lifespan and poor safety. Inspired by the role of plant root systems in anchoring soil, an oligomer‐anchored LiZn nanocrystal composite interphase is constructed on the Li metal anode via a simple spray‐coating strategy, simultaneously enhancing the electrochemical stability and thermal safety of Li metal batteries. The LiZn alloy in the composite interphase restructures the interface energy distribution and reduces the local current density, thereby facilitating uniform lateral Li deposition. The oligomer serves as a binder to glue LiZn particles together and preserve the structural integrity of the interphase. A Li||LiNi 0.5 Co 0.2 Mn 0.3 O 2 coin cell with the composite interphase exhibits a lifespan of 700 cycles at 1 C with a high cathode loading of 3.06 mAh cm −2 . The 1.38 Ah Li||LiNi 0.8 Co 0.1 Mn 0.1 O 2 pouch cell achieves a capacity retention of 86% after 200 cycles. When the cycled pouch cells undergo forced thermal runaway, the composite interphase elevates the trigger temperature from 124°C to 191°C. This interphase design provides novel insights to enhance the service lifespan and thermal safety of high energy density batteries.
papers.summary_ko: 리튬 금속 음극 표면에 올리고머로 LiZn 나노결정을 접착한 복합 계면층을 분무코팅으로 형성하여 전기화학적 안정성과 열적 안전성을 동시에 향상시켰다. LiZn 합금이 계면 에너지 분포를 재구성하고 국부 전류밀도를 낮춰 균일한 측방향 Li 증착을 유도하며, 올리고머는 LiZn 입자를 결착해 계면 구조를 유지한다. Li||NCM523 코인셀은 3.06 mAh cm⁻² 로딩에서 700회 사이클을 달성했고, 1.38Ah Li||NCM811 파우치셀은 200회 후 86%의 용량을 유지했으며 열폭주 트리거 온도를 124°C에서 191°C로 높였다.

papers.title: A Fluorinated 3D Interphase With Built‐In Si‐Gradient Lithiophilicity Enables Spatially Adaptive Li Deposition for Stable Li Metal Anode
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Li metal anodes, sought after for next‐generation high‐energy batteries, are severely hindered by dendritic growth and an unstable solid electrolyte interphase (SEI). Here, we design a fluorinated 3D artificial SEI with a built‐in vertical Si‐gradient lithiophilicity (3D F‐SiG SEI) via in situ copolymerization of hexafluorobutyl methacrylate and 2,4,6,8‐tetramethyl‐2,4,6,8‐tetraethynylcyclotetrasiloxane. Critically, this crosslinking reaction proceeds exclusively under the catalytic action of the Li metal substrate, ensuring seamless interfacial integration. The resulting porous SEI generates a continuous lithiophilicity gradient that homogenizes Li + flux, enforces “bottom‐up” pore‐filling deposition, and buffers volume fluctuations. Simultaneously, the F/Si‐rich chemistry promotes in situ formation of a stable LiF‐enriched Si‐based SEI, which reduces the nucleation overpotential and accelerates interfacial kinetics. The modified anode delivers an average Coulombic efficiency of 99.4% in half cells and ultralong cycling stability over 3500 h in symmetric cells. Full cells paired with LiFePO 4 and high‐nickel NCM cathodes exhibit superior capacity retention and rate capability even under high mass loading. This work provides a blueprint for simultaneously engineering interfacial deposition, buffering volume fluctuations, and enhancing air stability in practical Li metal anodes.
papers.summary_ko: 리튬 금속 음극 표면에 불소화 3차원 인공 SEI를 설계해 수직 방향 Si 농도구배를 통한 리튬친화성 구배를 구현했다. 이 계면은 Li 금속 촉매 작용으로만 가교중합이 진행되어 균일한 Li+ 플럭스를 유도하고 상향식 기공충전형 증착을 유도하며, F/Si가 풍부한 LiF 기반 SEI를 형성해 핵생성 과전위를 낮춘다. 개질된 음극은 반셀에서 평균 쿨롱효율 99.4%, 대칭셀에서 3500시간 이상의 장기 사이클 안정성을 보였고, LFP 및 고니켈 NCM 양극과의 완전셀에서도 우수한 용량유지율과 율속특성을 나타냈다.

papers.title: Ordered Macroporous Prussian Blue Analogues for Rechargeable Na‐Cl 2 Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Rechargeable Na‐Cl 2 batteries have emerged as a promising alternative and supplement for lithium‐ion batteries due to their ultra‐high energy density. Nevertheless, developing satisfactory cathode materials to facilitate the complex solid, liquid, and gas three‐phase conversion process during charge‐discharge cycling remains a significant challenge. Herein, we propose a three‐dimensional ordered macroporous Prussian blue analog (3DOM PBA) fabricated via a stepwise vacuum impregnation template strategy, which can serve as an ideal cathode material for rechargeable Na‐Cl 2 batteries. The hierarchically ordered porous structure arranging from micropores to macropores can provide appropriated channels for ions transfer, Cl 2 storage, and NaCl crystal deposition. Moreover, customizable metal site doping not only optimize the electronic and ionic conductivity but also provide efficient adsorption and in‐situ catalytic conversion sites for Cl 2 /Cl − , thereby effectively increasing the reversible reaction kinetics and long‐term cycling stability. As a result, the assembled Na‐Cl 2 battery delivers a reversible capacity of 2000 mAh g − 1 and stable cycling life of 2500 cycles at 15 000 mA g − 1 , which can still maintain reversible charge‐discharge behavior even at 30 000 mA g − 1 , much superior to the reported results. This study provides new insights for developing high‐performance electrode materials for rechargeable Na‐Cl 2 batteries.
papers.summary_ko: 재충전형 Na-Cl2 배터리는 초고에너지밀도로 리튬이온배터리의 대안으로 주목받고 있으나, 충방전 중 복잡한 고체-액체-기체 삼상 전환을 지원하는 캐소드 소재 개발이 과제로 남아있다. 이에 단계적 진공 침윤 템플릿법으로 3차원 규칙적 거대다공성 프러시안 블루 유사체(3DOM PBA)를 제작하여 이온 전달과 Cl2 저장, NaCl 결정 석출에 적합한 다공 채널을 구현했다. 맞춤형 금속 사이트 도핑으로 전자/이온 전도성과 Cl2/Cl- 흡착·촉매 전환 효율을 높여, 15,000 mA g-1에서 2000 mAh g-1의 가용 용량과 2500회의 안정적인 수명을 달성했다.

papers.title: Molecular Polarization Engineering Homogenizes Interfacial Potential for Long‐Life Wide‐Temperature Solid‐State Lithium Metal Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Lithium dendrite formation in solid‐state lithium metal batteries originates not only from mechanical failure but also from spatially heterogeneous interfacial electrostatic fields that induce localized Li + accumulation. However, existing electrolyte designs mainly regulate mechanical strength or chemical interfacial reactions, while dynamic regulation of interfacial electrostatic disorder remains unexplored. Here, we introduce an interfacial potential homogenization enabled by polarization‐mediated regulation. A molecularly entangled PEO/polyurethane/MOF‐177 electrolyte is constructed, where polar polymer networks and MOF polarization domains cooperatively redistribute local electric‐field fluctuations. This electrostatic regulation homogenizes Li + flux, lowers migration barriers, and suppresses preferential lithium nucleation. Consequently, CPEZ exhibits an ionic conductivity of 1.9 × 10 −3 S cm −1 and a Li + transference number of 0.71, both measured at 60°C. The Li/CPEZ/Li cell cycles stably for 9000 h at 0.1 mAh cm −2 . The Li/CPEZ/LFP retains 90 % capacity after 5000 at 1 C, while Li/CPEZ/LFP retains 85% capacity after 500 cycles at 100°C and cycles stably for 150 cycles at −15°C. This work establishes electrostatic regulation via polar interactions as a transferable design principle for durable, wide‐temperature solid‐state lithium metal batteries.
papers.summary_ko: 고체 리튬 금속 배터리의 리튬 덴드라이트는 기계적 결함뿐 아니라 계면의 불균일한 정전기장에 의한 국소적 Li+ 축적에서도 발생하는데, 기존 전해질 설계는 주로 기계적 강도나 화학적 반응만 조절해왔다. 본 연구는 PEO/폴리우레탄/MOF-177이 분자 수준으로 엉킨 전해질을 구성하여 분극 매개 계면 전위 균일화를 통해 Li+ 플럭스를 고르게 분포시키고 이동 장벽을 낮춰 우선적 리튬 핵성장을 억제한다. 이 전해질은 60°C에서 1.9×10-3 S cm-1의 이온전도도와 0.71의 Li+ 이동수를 보이며, Li/CPEZ/Li 셀은 9000시간 동안 안정적으로 구동되고 LFP 셀은 1C에서 5000회 후 90% 용량을 유지한다.

papers.title: Mechanochemical Regulating Competitive Phase Transformation of Fe 3 (PO 4 ) 2 Toward Industrial‐Grade Regenerated LiFePO 4
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Attracted by short‐process and uniform regenerated properties, oxidation‐homogenization then reduction‐reconstruction of spent LiFePO 4 (SLFP) has been successfully industrialized. Two types of SLFP exist: production scrap and cycled retired battery materials. Nevertheless, these treatments enable efficient regeneration of the former, yet fail to restore the latter effectively, always with unsatisfactory energy‐storage properties. From our experience, the introduced mechanochemical behaviors (MCB) would induce the tailoring of their properties. Herein, through the controlling of MCB, the evolution of physical‐chemical properties is revealed during the full‐loop process. MCB would induce the exposure of the metastable Li 1−x FePO 4 transition region. Clearly, along with the competition of carbon and O 2 , they were transformed into Fe 3 (PO 4 ) 2 intermediate coated with a dense Fe 2 O 3 layer, bringing about the uneven carbon layers and lattice stress distribution. By replacing ball milling with jet milling, excessive mechanical stress is avoided. The as‐optimized sample deliver a capacity of 148.2 mAh g −1 after 200 cycles at 1.0 C and 108.4 mAh g −1 after 1000 cycles at 5.0 C. Furthermore, kg‐scale experiments are conducted to prove the practical reliability of recycling manners. Thus, this work is expected to elucidate the full‐loop regeneration mechanism of cycled retired battery materials, meanwhile providing the significant treatment strategy for practical industry production.
papers.summary_ko: 폐LiFePO4(SLFP) 재생 공정에서 기계화학적 거동(MCB)이 Fe3(PO4)2 중간상으로의 경쟁적 상변화에 미치는 영향을 분석한 재활용 연구이다. 볼밀 대신 제트밀을 사용해 과도한 기계적 응력을 피함으로써 폐전지 재생 소재의 성능을 개선했다.

papers.title: Machine Learning-Driven Electrolyte Additive Discovery for Ultrafast Charging of Sodium Metal Batteries
papers.venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society
papers.abstract_en: Abstract Sodium metal batteries hold immense promise for large-scale, high-power storage systems, yet their fast charging is severely constrained by sluggish Na+ transport across unstable electrode–electrolyte interphases. Conventional fluorine-donating additives suffer from inefficient self-decomposition, inevitably generating resistive organic byproducts. Herein, we propose an active machine learning framework based on Gaussian process regression to develop an innovative additive-triggered anion decomposition pathway. Guided by iterative screening of key physicochemical descriptors, a trace-level (0.02 M) sodium chlorodifluoroacetate (NaCDFA) additive is successfully identified. Theoretical calculations combined with in situ characterizations reveal that the NaCDFA thermodynamically promotes the targeted and continuous decomposition of the PF6– anion, enabling the construction of robust and highly conductive NaF-rich interphases, which substantially reduces the Na+ migration barrier. Consequently, the Na||Na3V2(PO4)3 cell achieves ultrastable cycling over 50,000 cycles at an extreme rate of 200 C. Furthermore, outstanding performance is retained under rigorous practical conditions, including high-mass-loading cathodes and limited sodium excess or anode-free architectures. This work establishes a cost-effective trace-level electrolyte additive strategy for engineering fast-charging interphases, and demonstrates the transformative potential of machine learning-guided materials discovery for advancing battery technology.
papers.summary_ko: 소듐 금속 배터리의 고속 충전은 불안정한 전극-전해질 계면에서 느린 Na+ 전달로 제한되며, 기존 불소 공여형 첨가제는 비효율적 자가분해로 저항성 유기 부산물을 생성하는 문제가 있다. 본 연구는 가우시안 과정 회귀 기반 능동 머신러닝 프레임워크로 핵심 물성 디스크립터를 반복 스크리닝하여 미량(0.02M)의 소듐 클로로디플루오로아세테이트(NaCDFA) 첨가제를 발굴했다. 이 첨가제는 PF6- 음이온의 표적 분해를 촉진해 NaF가 풍부한 전도성 계면을 형성, Na+ 이동 장벽을 크게 낮추어 Na||Na3V2(PO4)3 셀이 200C의 극한 속도에서 50,000회 이상 초안정적으로 구동되도록 한다.

papers.title: Full-sunlight-driven photocatalytic recovery of critical metals from spent lithium-ion batteries via organic acid leaching
papers.abstract_en: The rapidly increasing deployment of secondary batteries has intensified pressures on resource security and waste management, exposing fundamental limitations of current battery recycling technologies that require intensive use of energy and chemicals. To enable sustainable battery waste management, systems must improve economic and environmental feasibility at the process level while retaining versatility toward diverse cathode chemistries. Here, we report a sunlight-driven photocatalytic leaching framework that enables robust recovery of critical metals from diverse commercial cathode materials. The process couples mild organic acids with a reusable photocatalyst to orchestrate a twofold leaching mechanism driven by sunlight, in which hydrogen peroxide is generated in situ across the solar spectrum and further activated by UV components to enhance metal extraction without external oxidizing agents. Importantly, the system maintains consistent performance over multiple operation cycles, supporting process robustness and scalability. Beyond its technical performance, techno-economic and life cycle analyses demonstrate clear advantages over conventional recycling methods, including lower energy inputs and reduced greenhouse gas emissions. This work establishes a versatile, profitable, and environmentally benign approach to battery recycling, offering a scalable pathway toward a sustainable circular economy. Researchers developed a light-driven method using organic acids to recover critical metals from used lithium-ion batteries, offering a more sustainable route for battery recycling powered by natural sunlight.
papers.summary_ko: 폐리튬이온배터리의 자원 회수를 위해 태양광으로 구동되는 광촉매 침출 공정을 제안한다. 유기산과 재사용 가능한 광촉매를 결합해 태양광 스펙트럼 전역에서 과산화수소를 현장 생성하고 UV로 활성화함으로써 외부 산화제 없이 다양한 상용 캐소드 소재에서 핵심 금속을 회수한다. 기술경제성 및 전과정 평가 결과 기존 재활용법보다 에너지 투입과 온실가스 배출이 낮아 지속가능한 순환경제에 기여할 수 있음을 보였다.

papers.title: Breaking the Capacity‐Reversibility Linear Trade‐Off in Li–O 2 Batteries via Amorphous Non‐Precious High‐Entropy Alloy Catalysts
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Lithium–oxygen (Li–O 2 ) batteries suffer from sluggish reaction kinetics and rely on precious metal‐based catalysts to facilitate the reaction process. Despite being effective, these costly catalysts would inevitably introduce a critical trade‐off between capacity and reversibility, compromising the high energy density advantage of Li–O 2 batteries. In this study, we have designed an amorphous non‐precious MnFeCoNiCu high‐entropy alloy (A‐HEA) catalyst via a mild liquid‐phase reduction strategy to break the above inherent linear trade‐off. The amorphous and porous structure of A‐HEA could provide a large electrochemical active surface area, diluting the local current density to promote the solution‐mediated discharge pathway. This enables the growth of large‐sized Li 2 O 2 to deliver a discharge capacity reaching 10.8 mAh cm −2 . Additionally, the multielemental synergistic electron redistribution of A‐HEA optimizes the d ‐band center to strengthen the LiO 2 adsorption and weaken the O─O bonding, reducing the overpotential to 0.75 V and extending the battery lifetime by 4−5 times compared to the crystalline counterparts. Importantly, the A‐HEA can be produced at a scale of over 100 g and works well in Li–O 2 pouch cells with a rate capability up to 400 mA and an energy density of 754 Wh kg −1 (560 Wh kg −1 even at −30°C).
papers.summary_ko: 리튬-산소 전지에서 귀금속 촉매가 유발하는 용량-가역성 간의 선형 트레이드오프를 비정질 비귀금속 고엔트로피 합금(MnFeCoNiCu, A-HEA) 촉매로 해결한 연구이다. 비정질 다공성 구조가 전기화학 활성 표면적을 넓혀 국부 전류밀도를 분산시키고 d-band center 최적화를 통해 과전압을 낮춰 결정질 대비 수명을 4~5배 연장했으며, 100g 이상 스케일 생산과 파우치셀에서 754 Wh kg-1(−30°C에서도 560 Wh kg-1)의 에너지밀도를 달성했다.

papers.title: A General Deep Eutectic Solvent‐Mediated Scalable Preparation of Halide Solid‐State Electrolytes for All‐Solid‐State Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT In the pursuit of high‐energy‐density all‐solid‐state lithium batteries, halide solid‐state electrolytes (HSSEs) have attracted increasing interest due to their high ionic conductivity and superior high‐voltage stability. Developing cost‐effective and scalable preparation methods is essential for their practical deployment, yet the current mainstream solid‐state preparation routes either require stringent environmental control with prohibitive costs or suffer from low efficiency. Herein, we report a universal deep eutectic solvent (DES)‐mediated wet‐chemical method that enables the efficient and scalable preparation of HSSEs. Taking Li 3 YCl 6 as a typical HSSE, we revealed the competitive coordination and hydrogen‐bond formation mechanisms through combined modeling and experiments. This method shows low cost, and good scalability for various HSSEs, and the resultant HSSEs show a similar conductivity (>0.30 mS cm −1 ) as that prepared by the solid‐state mechanical method. Notably, the humidity‐degraded HSSEs can also be readily regenerated by this method. The all‐solid‐state lithium batteries assembled with the resultant Li 3 YCl 6 deliver impressive performance, achieving a high initial Coulombic efficiency of 98.6% with a LiCoO 2 cathode and a remarkable discharge capacity of 195.9 mAh g −1 with a single‐crystal LiNi 0.8 Co 0.1 Mn 0.1 O 2 cathode. This work establishes a new paradigm for the sustainable and scalable manufacturing of HSSEs for next‐generation all‐solid‐state batteries.
papers.summary_ko: 할라이드계 고체전해질(HSSE)을 심층 공융 용매(DES) 매개 습식화학 방법으로 저비용, 대량 합성하는 범용 공정을 제안한 전해질 연구이다. Li3YCl6를 대표 소재로 경쟁적 배위 및 수소결합 형성 메커니즘을 규명했으며, 습도로 손상된 HSSE도 동일 방법으로 재생할 수 있음을 보였다.

papers.title: Super‐Toughness Self‐Healing Composite Solid Electrolyte With Structured Interfacial Reconstruction Enabling Fast Ion Transport and Stable Interface for High‐Performance Solid‐State Lithium Metal Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Lithium–metal batteries are widely regarded as a key direction for next‐generation energy storage systems due to high energy density. However, LiNi 0 . 8 Co 0 . 1 Mn 0 . 1 O 2 ||Li battery systems face severe challenges in practical application, including lithium dendrite growth, interfacial side reactions and structural degradation of high‐nickel cathodes. Here, we proposed a versatile modification strategy combining in‐situ interfacial transformation with polymer phase regulation to fabricate self‐healing solid polymer electrolyte with fast ion transport and stable interface. This strategy not only constructs fast ion channels and suppresses hydrofluoric acid production by in‐situ converting Li 2 CO 3 on the Li 6.4 La 3 Zr 1.4 Ta 0.6 O 12 surface into Li 2 PO 3 F interfacial layer, but also induces the transition of PVDF from α‐phase to high polarity β‐phase using ethylenediaminetetraacetic acid to promote lithium salt dissolution and reduce Li + migration resistance. The as‐prepared electrolyte exhibits extended electrochemical voltage windows (5.13 V), high room‐temperature ionic conductivity (1.694 mS cm − 1 ), excellent thermal stability (200°C), high elongation at break (422.6%), and superior cycling stability (89.4% retention after 500 cycles at 1 C). A non‐destructive monitoring method based on d p /|d Q | and d T /|d Q | differential signals has been developed to track electrochemical‐mechanical‐thermal responses during battery operation. This work provides an effective strategy for designing solid polymer electrolytes with high ionic conductivity and interfacial stability.
papers.summary_ko: 리튬 금속 음극의 덴드라이트 성장과 고니켈 NCM811 양극의 계면 부반응을 해결하기 위해 자가치유형 복합 고체 전해질을 제안했다. LLZO 표면의 Li2CO3를 Li2PO3F 계면층으로 전환하고 PVDF를 고분극성 β상으로 유도해 빠른 이온 전달 경로와 안정적 계면을 구현했다. 이 전해질은 5.13V의 전기화학 안정성 창, 1.694 mS/cm의 상온 이온전도도, 422.6%의 신율, 500회 사이클 후 89.4%의 용량 유지율을 보였으며, 전기화학-기계-열 반응을 동시 모니터링하는 비파괴 진단법도 함께 제시했다.

papers.title: Stress‐Regulated Li Plating in Hybrid Ag–Carbon/Carbon Nanofiber Anodes for Durable All‐Solid‐State Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT All‐solid‐state batteries (ASSBs) with Li‐metal or Li‐metal‐free anodes enable high energy density, yet high‐loading cathodes induce severe mechanical instability, leading to rapid cell failure. Herein, we identify stress accumulation caused by repetitive Li plating/stripping as a critical degradation origin in ASSBs and propose a mechanically adaptive Ag–carbon/carbon nanofiber (CNF) hybrid anode to address this challenge. Operando pressure analysis and mechanical modeling reveal that increasing cathode areal capacity substantially amplifies pressure fluctuations and dynamic mechanical instability, leading to interfacial disruption and short‐circuiting. To mitigate this behavior, the Ag–C interlayer and porous CNF framework were independently customized to provide complementary electrochemical regulation and mechanical buffering functions. The Ag–C layer promotes uniform Li nucleation through Ag–Li alloy‐assisted interfacial regulation, while the porous CNF host accommodates volumetric changes and dissipates stress. Phase‐field modeling and microstructural analyses reveal sequential Ag–Li alloying within the Ag–C interlayer, CNF lithiation and pore filling, and controlled interfacial Li deposition, thereby spatially redistributing volumetric expansion. Consequently, the Ag–C/CNF architecture significantly reduces pressure fluctuation and enables stable cycling over 250 cycles under high‐loading conditions (∼5 mAh cm −2 ). Furthermore, stable pouch‐cell operation is demonstrated under practical stack pressures of 1 and 2 MPa, highlighting a viable strategy for mechanically robust high‐energy‐density ASSBs.
papers.summary_ko: 전고체전지에서 리튬 도금/탈리 반복에 따른 응력 축적이 주요 셀 실패 원인임을 규명하고, 이를 완화하기 위한 기계적 적응형 Ag-탄소/탄소나노섬유(CNF) 하이브리드 음극을 제안했다. Ag-C 계면층은 Ag-Li 합금화를 통한 균일한 Li 핵생성을 유도하고 다공성 CNF 프레임워크는 체적 변화를 수용하며 응력을 분산시킨다. 고로딩 조건(~5 mAh cm-2)에서 250회 이상 안정적 사이클과 1~2 MPa의 실용적 스택 압력에서의 파우치셀 구동을 입증했다.

papers.title: Non‐Selective Suppression of Cation and Anion Crosstalk from an Anode Perspective
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Metal fluoride and sulfur cathodes are appealing for their abundance and high capacity but are plagued by severe electrode crosstalk. This occurs when transition metal cations or polysulfide anions dissolve and shuttle to the anode, causing corrosion and rapid capacity fade. Herein, we propose an anode‐centric mechanism utilizing a Na‐rich nanoalloy (Na x Sn) anode that achieves simultaneous kinetic regulation and physical shielding, suppressing cation and anion crosstalk at both the source and destination. The ultrafast kinetics of the Na x Sn alloy elevate the Damköhler number (Da), a descriptor quantifying the competition between conversion and diffusion, thereby ensuring these species are rapidly reduced at the cathode prior to outward diffusion. Concurrently, this nanoalloy induces the formation of an ultrathin, robust Na 2 O‐rich solid electrolyte interphase that non‐selectively blocks residual cation and anion crossovers. This mechanism enables an FeF 2 ||Na x Sn full cell to achieve a Coulombic efficiency of 99.93% over 200 cycles. Additionally, the S/C||Na x Sn system supports extreme rate capabilities (630 mAh g −1 at 20C) and transitions to practical pouch cell configurations, yielding an excellent capacity retention of 91.95% after 1000 cycles at 0.5C. Ultimately, Na‐rich nanoalloy anodes offer a compelling pathway toward high‐energy, sustainable batteries by transforming electrode crosstalk into a spatiotemporally synergistic anode‐cathode coupling.

papers.title: High‐Entropy Complementary d‐Band Decoupling of Redox Kinetics for Bidirectional Catalysis in Lithium–Sulfur Batteries
papers.abstract_en: S in lithium-sulfur (Li-S) batteries is limited by the bidirectional redox kinetics. A single-component catalyst is difficult to simultaneously meet the differentiated adsorption and catalytic requirements in the multi-step conversion of polysulfides. We propose a high-entropy complementary d-band center model, extending the classical d-band center theory to multi-metal systems. The complementary d-band centers of multiple metals align the HOMO and LUMO of sulfur species, coordinating the electron transfer balance and accelerating the redox kinetics. The multi-metal sites collaboratively construct a "highly efficient capture → cascade conversion → rapid desorption" closed-loop pathway, with the d-p hybridization network regulating the adsorption energy and effectively suppressing the shuttle effect. Based on this design, the high-entropy selenide catalyst with a customized electronic structure and strong synergy effect has achieved excellent cycle stability and rate performance in Li-S batteries.

papers.title: Glycosaminoglycans Promote Amyloid-β Aggregation via Multivalent, pH-Dependent Interactions
papers.venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society
papers.abstract_en: Abstract Glycosaminoglycans (GAGs) are polyanionic polysaccharides that colocalize with amyloid deposits in Alzheimer’s disease, yet their mechanistic contribution to aggregation remains unclear. Here, we show that GAGs function as pH-responsive electrostatic scaffolds that selectively accelerate Aβ(1–42) aggregation under mildly acidic, early endosomal-like conditions but not at neutral pH. Combining experimental and computational approaches, we identify protonated N-terminal histidines as key determinants of GAG binding. Weak interactions between GAGs and the charged N-terminal region of Aβ promote conformational rearrangements that bring peptides into proximity and expose adjacent hydrophobic aggregation-prone segments, thereby facilitating peptide clustering. Kinetic analyses reveal that aggregation is enhanced in a way consistent with an apparent increase in effective peptide concentration, accelerating nucleation without altering the dominant aggregation pathway. Systematic variation of GAG chain length and sulfation level further demonstrates that aggregation enhancement requires a threshold degree of multivalency, consistent with a clustering-driven mechanism. Together, these findings establish a framework in which pH-dependent polyelectrolyte interactions act as molecular triggers of amyloid nucleation and define the physicochemical parameters that govern when GAGs transition from passive interaction partners to active promoters of Aβ aggregation, providing insight into how cellular microenvironments may regulate the earliest stages of Alzheimer’s disease pathology.

papers.title: Electrolyte‐Enabled Suppression of Static Corrosion for Long‐Cycle Calendar Life in Lithium Metal Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT The calendar life of lithium (Li) metal batteries is commonly evaluated through cycling performance, implicitly assuming that storage‐induced degradation follows the same interfacial processes. However, this work reveals that Li metal undergoes continuous non‐Faradaic interfacial corrosion under open‐circuit conditions, defining a distinct degradation pathway governing calendar aging, distinct from cycling‐induced failure. To quantify this process, we introduce a kinetically defined descriptor based on the degradation rate constant (λ), enabling direct evaluation of time‐dependent capacity loss during storage. This framework treats calendar aging as a corrosion‐driven kinetic process rather than an extrapolation of cycling behavior. We further show that static corrosion can be actively regulated via electrolyte design. Based on the degradation rate constants derived from capacity decay fitting, the LiNO 3 ‐15C5‐CsBr electrolyte projects a 2.7‐fold extension in storage lifetime at 100% SOC and a 3.4‐fold extension at 0% SOC versus the baseline electrolyte. Mechanistically, Cs + ‐mediated electrostatic shielding, Br − ‐induced interfacial polishing, and NO 3 − ‐derived inorganic passivation cooperatively stabilize the Li interface, suppress corrosion kinetics, and reduce irreversible Li loss, leading to a marked decrease in λ. These findings establish static corrosion as a distinct degradation mode in Li metal batteries and provide a quantitative framework for evaluating and regulating calendar aging beyond cycling metrics.
papers.summary_ko: 리튬 금속 전지의 저장(캘린더) 수명 저하가 사이클과 무관한 비파라데이식 계면 부식에 의해 발생함을 규명하고, 분해 속도상수(λ) 기반의 정량적 평가 프레임워크를 제안했다. LiNO3-15C5-CsBr 전해질은 기존 대비 100% SOC에서 2.7배, 0% SOC에서 3.4배의 저장 수명 연장을 나타냈으며, Cs+ 정전기적 차폐, Br− 계면 평활화, NO3− 무기 피막 형성이 복합적으로 Li 계면을 안정화하는 메커니즘을 제시했다.

papers.title: Electrolyte-dependent physico-chemical interfacial kinetics shape degradation pathways and lifetime in lithium-ion batteries
papers.abstract_en: Abstract Electrolyte-dependent lifetime variability remains a major obstacle to sustainable deployment of lithium-ion batteries, contributing to premature retirement, increased material demand and uncertainty in lifecycle assessment. However, most continuum degradation models represent the electrolyte through bulk transport, without capturing its role in interfacial degradation. Here, we use customised multi-layer pouch cells with varied ethylene carbonate:dimethyl carbonate ratio, lithium hexafluorophosphate concentration and electrolyte amount to examine how electrolyte conditions shape degradation trajectories under accelerated degradation. Within this formulation framework, changing the solvent ratio leads to distinct lifetime trajectories across otherwise comparable cells. Electrochemical diagnostics, gas analysis and post-mortem interfacial characterisation show that this divergence is associated with electrolyte-sensitive interphase growth, parasitic reactions and spatially heterogeneous surface degradation. We incorporate electrolyte-dependent transport and thermodynamic properties into a physics-based degradation model. A transport-only implementation does not reproduce the observed separation in capacity-retention trajectories. Introducing a minimal electrolyte-sensitive refinement through an effective interphase transport parameter improves agreement in the ethylene-carbonate-rich case. These results identify electrolyte-sensitive interfacial degradation as a necessary modelling dimension for reliable lifetime prediction.

papers.title: Core–Shell Solvation Structure Engineering Enables Practical Lithium Metal Batteries With 475 Wh Kg −1
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Lithium metal batteries (LMBs) offer extremely high theoretical energy densities, but face significant challenges in terms of electrolyte compatibility and interface stability. Existing low‐concentration electrolytes struggle to form a robust solid‐electrolyte interface to maintain stable cycling. Here, we designed a low‐concentration electrolyte based on a functionally partitioned core–shell solvation strategy. Methyl sulfone, possessing a relatively high donor number, dominates the primary Li + coordination domain, while fluoroethylene carbonate, with a low donor number and low viscosity, primarily regulates the outer solvation environment and interfacial chemistry. This design facilitates rapid desolvation, high ionic conductivity (4.42 mS cm −1 ), and an exceptionally high Li + transference number (0.74). The core–shell structure induces a gradient SEI, promoting uniform lithium deposition. Consequently, the LiFePO 4 (LFP)||Li cell achieved capacity retention of 85.9% after 5000 cycles at 1 C, along with cycling stability from −10°C to 50°C. Practical application was further confirmed by stable cycling of NCM811||Li pouch cells (200 cycles, 95.7%) and NCM811||graphite pouch cells (650 cycles, 88.5%). Furthermore, a 2.2 Ah NCM811||Li pouch cell achieves a gravimetric energy density of 475 Wh kg −1 . This work presents a scalable approach to engineering solvation chemistries for high‐voltage and high‐energy‐density LMBs.

papers.title: Cathode‐Driven Aluminothermic Fronts Amplify Thermal Runaway in Lithium‐Ion Batteries
papers.abstract_en: Thermal runaway in lithium-ion batteries often develops from a local failure into a spatially propagating high-temperature front. Here, we show that oxygen-bearing cathode materials and metallic aluminium can form self-sustained, glowing, cathode-driven aluminothermic fronts in inert gas as a heat-amplification pathway relevant to severe thermal runaway. Using a mesoscale platform based on semi-1D composite bars, we isolate this interfacial redox chemistry from gas-phase combustion, internal short-circuit heating, and other coupled cell-failure processes. Nickel-rich layered oxide/aluminium bars sustain aluminothermic-front propagation in argon, with velocities of the same order of magnitude as reported thermal-runaway fronts. By varying aluminium loading, reaction atmosphere and cathode chemistry, we show that front propagation depends on aluminium fuel supply, the oxygen-donor capability of the cathode, and access to oxygen gas. Crystalline phase and chemical-state analyses reveal Li-Al-O/Al-O products together with reduced or reconstructed transition-metal species, supporting cathode-to-aluminium oxygen transfer as the underlying redox pathway. For a representative 2-Ah cell, energy-audit calculations indicate that the aluminium-cathode reaction gives a potential heat scale equivalent to about half of the stored electrical energy. These findings identify cathode-Al redox chemistry as an internal heat-amplification mechanism that should be considered in battery hazard assessment and high-energy-cell safety design.

papers.title: Building‐Block Design of Nonflammable Quasi‐Solid Electrolytes for Ampere‐Hour‐Scale Sodium‐Ion Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Sodium‐ion batteries (SIBs) are emerging as a competitive technology for large‐scale energy storage; however, their commercial viability remains severely hindered by the inherent flammability and high volatility of liquid electrolytes (LEs). Herein, we propose a modular assembly strategy inspired by the building‐block principle to architect a quasi‐solid electrolyte (QSE). By synergistically integrating vinylene carbonate (VC) and 2,2,3,4,4,4‐hexafluorobutyl acrylate (HFBA) monomers, we modulate the electron density distribution within the polymer matrix. The resulting PVH QSE lowers the Na + desolvation barrier and provides continuous ion migration pathways, thereby achieving exceptional ionic conductivity of 5.60 mS cm −1 and a sodium‐ion transference number of 0.58. Furthermore, the spatially locked polymer architecture drives the formation of ion‐solvent aggregates and a robust NaF‐rich solid electrolyte interphase, synergistically suppressing solvent decomposition and eradicating sodium dendrite growth. Consequently, the Na||Na 3 V 2 (PO 4 ) 3 cells exhibit an outstanding capacity retention of 94.9% after 3000 cycles alongside superior temperature adaptability. To demonstrate practical feasibility, the hard carbon||NaNi 0.33 Fe 0.33 Mn 0.33 O 2 pouch cells maintain stable cycling over 200 cycles. Crucially, nail penetration and accelerating rate calorimetry (ARC) tests verify the exceptional safety of the pouch cells. By linking molecular microenvironment regulation to macroscopic battery safety, this work illuminates a viable pathway toward the commercialization of intrinsically safe SIBs.
papers.summary_ko: 소듐이온전지용 난연성 준고체 전해질(QSE)을 비닐렌카보네이트와 불소화 아크릴레이트 단량체의 빌딩블록 조립 전략으로 설계했다. 이 QSE는 Na+ 탈솔베이션 장벽을 낮추고 NaF 풍부 SEI를 형성해 소듐 덴드라이트 성장을 억제하며, 5.60 mS/cm의 이온전도도와 0.58의 Na+ 이동수를 나타냈다. Na||Na3V2(PO4)3 셀은 3000회 사이클 후 94.9%의 용량 유지율을 보였고, 못뚫기 및 ARC 시험으로 파우치셀의 안전성이 입증되었다.

papers.title: Breaking Quasi‐Chelation in Thioether Electrolytes for Synergistic Interfacial Stabilization in Lithium‐Sulfur Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Lithium‐sulfur batteries (LSBs) have attracted extensive attention owing to their high energy density. However, their development remains severely hindered by sluggish interfacial reaction kinetics, unstable electrode–electrolyte interphases, lithium dendrite growth, and polysulfide shuttling. In this work, we identify a hidden quasi‐chelation effect in ether‐based nitrile solvents, which undermines the effectiveness of weakly solvating electrolyte design, and demonstrate that this limitation can be effectively overcome through a thioether‐substitution strategy. Specifically, replacing the ether oxygen in methoxyacetonitrile with sulfur to form (methylthio)acetonitrile disrupts the quasi‐chelating coordination motif and weakens solvent‐Li + interactions, and induces anion‐rich solvation structures. Spectroscopic characterizations combined with molecular dynamics simulations reveal that breaking this quasi‐chelation effect lowers the Li + desolvation barrier and accelerates ion‐transport kinetics. Meanwhile, the preferential decomposition of the thioether solvent promotes the formation of sulfur‐rich, inorganic‐dominated interphases, thereby enabling simultaneous stabilization of both the lithium metal anode and the SPAN cathode. As a result, lithium dendrite growth and polysulfide shuttling are effectively suppressed, and Li||SPAN full cells retain 86% of their initial capacity after 600 cycles under high‐loading conditions. This work demonstrates that quasi‐chelation breaking can serve as an effective molecular design principle for constructing weakly solvating electrolytes toward practical lithium‐sulfur batteries.
papers.summary_ko: 리튬-황전지 전해질에서 에테르계 나이트릴 용매가 보이는 숨겨진 유사 킬레이션 효과를 규명하고, 황으로 치환한 티오에테르 용매((메틸티오)아세토니트릴)로 이를 해소하는 전략을 제시했다. 이 치환은 Li+ 탈솔베이션 장벽을 낮추고 황 풍부 무기질 계면을 형성해 리튬 금속 음극과 SPAN 양극을 동시에 안정화했다. 그 결과 Li||SPAN 완전셀은 고로딩 조건에서 600회 사이클 후 86%의 용량을 유지하며 덴드라이트 성장과 폴리설파이드 셔틀을 효과적으로 억제했다.

papers.title: A Sustainable Fully Fluorine‐Free Interfacial Chemistry for Reversible Anode‐Free Lithium Metal Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Anode‐free lithium metal batteries promise high energy density. However, fluorinated electrolytes raise sustainability concerns. Herein, we develop a fully fluorine‐free interfacial strategy by coupling a cross‐linked vinylene carbonate‐N,N′‐methylenebisacrylamide artificial solid electrolyte interphase (ASEI) on Cu current collectors with a fluorine‐free electrolyte to regulate both lithium deposition and subsequent SEI formation. This combination offers an alternative to interfacial stabilization using fluorinated SEI‐forming components or alloy‐forming interlayers. The ASEI possesses strong Li‐ASEI interactions and enhanced lithiophilicity, thereby enabling homogeneous and compact Li deposition with reduced growth overpotential. Furthermore, the ASEI induces the formation of a conformal, mechanically robust, inorganic‐rich SEI containing Li 2 O and Li 3 N, leading to improved interfacial stability and the reversibility of Li plating/stripping. Consequently, the ASEI‐modified current collector delivers markedly improved full‐cell performance. The prelithiated LFP||ASEI‐Cu full cell achieves stable cycling over 350 cycles with a capacity retention of 84.5% at 25°C, while the prelithiated NCM811||ASEI‐Cu full cell delivers a reversible capacity of 146.8 mAh g −1 after 100 cycles with a capacity retention of 86.6% at 25°C. This work demonstrates the potential of fluorine‐free interfacial engineering for anode‐free lithium metal batteries, while further improvements in lithium‐inventory retention and high‐current‐density operation remain necessary for practical implementation.
papers.summary_ko: 무불소 전해질과 가교형 비닐렌카보네이트-메틸렌비스아크릴아마이드 기반 인공 SEI(ASEI)를 구리 집전체에 결합하여 완전 무불소 계면화학으로 음극-프리 리튬 금속 전지를 구현했다. ASEI는 리튬친화성이 높아 균일하고 조밀한 리튬 증착을 유도하며 Li2O와 Li3N이 풍부한 무기질 SEI를 형성해 가역성을 향상시켰다. 프리리튬화 LFP||ASEI-Cu 셀은 350회 사이클에서 84.5%, NCM811||ASEI-Cu 셀은 100회 사이클에서 86.6%의 용량 유지율을 보였다.

papers.title: A Multi‐Topologically Superposed Mechanically Interlocked Polymer
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Mechanically interlocked structures (MIS) provide a powerful platform for creating advanced materials with unprecedented topological architectures. Nevertheless, current related studies have predominantly focused on the construction of MIS with single topological motifs, and the integration of multiple topologies into a single MIS remains a grand challenge. Herein, we harness ligand conformational constraints to regulate the flexible coordination behavior of alkali metal ions, enabling the construction of a multi‐topologically superposed mechanically interlocked polymer ( MIP ) featuring the unprecedented incorporation of four distinct topological motifs. This incorporation imparts MIP with exceptional mechanical strength and efficient Na + transport capability. As an artificial solid electrolyte interphase (ASEI) for sodium metal batteries, MIP delivers remarkable ultralong cycling stability, maintaining 87.8% capacity retention after 10 000 cycles at 20 C. This work breaks the boundaries of conventional MIS by enabling the creation of multi‐topologically superposed MIS, thereby unveiling new topological landscapes and opening unexplored opportunities for advanced functions.
papers.summary_ko: 기계적으로 맞물린 구조(MIS)는 독특한 위상구조를 갖는 소재 플랫폼이지만 기존 연구는 단일 위상 모티프에 국한되어 있었다. 본 연구는 리간드의 형태적 제약을 이용해 알칼리 금속 이온의 유연한 배위 거동을 조절함으로써 네 가지 서로 다른 위상 모티프를 하나의 사슬에 결합한 다중위상 중첩형 기계적 맞물림 고분자(MIP)를 구현했다. 이 고분자는 우수한 기계적 강도와 효율적인 Na+ 전달 능력을 가져, 소듐 금속 배터리용 인공 고체전해질계면(ASEI)으로 적용 시 20C에서 10,000회 순환 후에도 87.8%의 용량 유지율을 보이는 초장수명 안정성을 달성했다.

papers.title: Weak‑Solvation‑Mediated Localized High‑Concentration Electrolyte for Sodium Metal Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Sodium metal batteries offer high energy density and material sustainability, yet their practical viability is severely compromised by the intrinsic instability of sodium metal anodes. Herein, we report a localized high‑concentration structure formed in a moderate‑solvating electrolyte by introducing methyl tert‑butyl ether (MTBE) as a fluorine‑free, weakly coordinating diluent in tetrahydrofuran (THF)/NaFSI electrolyte. MTBE displaces free THF molecules, promotes FSI − incorporation into the inner solvation sheath, and transforms the solvation structure from solvent‑separated ion pairs to contact ion pairs and aggregates. This diluent‑participated solvation, with its weak interaction with Na + , accelerates desolvation kinetics and forms a robust, anion‑derived inorganic‑rich interphase that suppresses parasitic reactions, dendrites, and corrosion. The optimal electrolyte enables Na||Na 4 Fe 3 (PO 4 ) 2 P 2 O 7 cells to deliver 74.3 mAh g −1 at 5.0 A g −1 and remarkable cycling stability with a high‐loading cathode (12 mg cm −2 ) over 600 cycles. A pouch cell sustains 300 cycles with a capacity of 92.4 mAh g −1 at 0.1 A g −1 . This work demonstrates a sustainable, polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS)‑free electrolyte design based on weak solvation engineering, offering a practical route toward stable and fast‑charging sodium metal batteries with enhanced cathode compatibility.

MTBE는 자유 THF를 밀어내고 FSI−를 내부 솔베이션에 더 많이 참여시켜 탈솔베이션을 가속화하고 음이온 유래의 무기질 계면을 형성해 부반응, 덴드라이트, 부식을 억제했다. 이 전해질은 Na||Na4Fe3(PO4)2P2O7 셀에서 5.0 A/g에서 74.3 mAh/g을 전달하고 고로딩 양극으로 600회 사이클 안정성을 보였으며, 파우치셀은 300회 사이클에서 92.4 mAh/g을 유지했다.

papers.title: Tailoring Covalent Organic Frameworks as Functionalized Molecular Traps to Enable Sulfur Conversion and Li + Desolvation for Durable Lithium–Sulfur Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Suppressing polysulfid shuttling and enhancing Li + desolvation kinetics are crucial for high‐performance lithium–sulfur (Li─S) batteries. Herein, we propose an elaborate molecular trap design strategy based on functional‐group decoupling and synergistic enhancement in covalent organic frameworks (COFs) to resolve the aforementioned issues. A cyano‐containing COF (CN‐COF) and its amidoxime derivative (COF‐AO) serve as cooperative dual‐sided separator coatings. CN‐COF contributes a well‐ordered porous structure for confining sulfur species; its C≡N sites interact with polysulfides to reduce the reaction energy barrier of sulfur conversion. On the anode side, ─NH 2 /─OH groups in COF‐AO promote Li + desolvation and modulate Li + transport by capturing solvent molecules via hydrogen bonding, which suppresses parasitic reactions and ensures rapid Li + migration. Besides, the regular topological structure and size‐exclusion effect of COF restrict migration of large‐sized solvent molecules and polysulfides, enabling homogeneous Li + flux and smooth Li deposition. Benefiting from these advantages, Li||Li symmetrical cells achieve stable cycling for 7000 h at 5 mA cm −2 /5 mAh cm −2 . The Li─S battery delivers an initial capacity of 820 mAh g −1 with an ultralow decay rate of 0.024% per cycle over 900 cycles at 5 C.The pouch cell exhibits a high initial capacity of 1020 mAh g −1 at 0.2 C and stable operation for 150 cycles.
papers.summary_ko: 리튬-황 전지에서 폴리설파이드 셔틀 억제와 Li+ 탈솔베이션을 동시에 달성하기 위해 작용기를 분리 설계한 공유결합유기골격체(COF) 분자 트랩을 제안했다. 시아노기를 가진 CN-COF는 양극 측에서 황종을 가두고 전환 반응의 에너지 장벽을 낮추며, 아미독심 유도체 COF-AO는 음극 측에서 수소결합으로 용매 분자를 포획해 Li+ 탈솔베이션과 균일한 Li 증착을 돕는다. Li||Li 대칭셀은 5 mA cm-2/5 mAh cm-2에서 7000시간 안정 사이클을, 전지는 5C/900사이클에서 0.024%/사이클의 낮은 감쇠율을 보였다.

papers.title: In Situ Constructed Fluorosulfided Interface With Metallic Mo Sites for Robust Anode‐Free Sodium Metal Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Anode‑free sodium metal batteries (AFSMBs) are acclaimed for their low‑cost, sustainability, and high energy density. However, achieving highly reversible Na plating/stripping on bare current collectors (CCs) and robust solid electrolyte interphase (SEI) is challenging. Herein, we present a robust fluorosulfided SEI (FS‐SEI) layer with metallic Mo active sites through in situ electrochemical transformation of 2D MoS 2 coating on the Cu CCs. Specifically, the ingenious 2D MoS 2 holds short ion transport pathways and large contact active areas during battery operation. Furthermore, MoS 2 can in situ convert into metallic Mo and Na 2 S, while catalyzing the dissolution of NaPF 6 to generate NaF. The in situ formed FS‐SEI film possesses excellent sodiophilicity, high Na + diffusion, and good electron‐blocking capability, which effectively guides a homogeneous distribution of Na + flux, accelerates the electrochemical reaction kinetics, and blocks side reactions between electrolyte and electrodes. Benefiting from these advantages, the MoS 2 @Cu half cells achieve average Coulombic efficiency of 99.85% over 350 cycles at 10 mA cm −2 and 10 mAh cm −2 . When paired with Na 3 V 2 (PO 4 ) 3 cathodes, the AFSMBs exhibit excellent rate capability and cycling stability (>97.0% retention). This work offers insights into engineering a stable in situ SEI via 2D sodiophilic architectures, paving the way for developing energy‐dense and durable AFSMBs.

papers.title: Direct Evidence of Intermediate Oxygen Species Evolution in Cathode Oxides With Nominally Stable Superstructure
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Anionic redox has fundamentally transformed the traditional approach to developing advanced cathode materials for secondary batteries. Nevertheless, how oxygen anions participate in the redox reaction and evolve during the dynamic intercalation process remains a topic of intense controversy, particularly in prototypical materials featuring a stable superstructure. Herein, we showcase that the oxidized oxygen species at the top of charge of ribbon‐ordered P2‐Na 0.6 Li 0.2 Mn 0.8 O 2 continuously evolve during electrochemical cycling—shifting from a mixture of electron holes on O 2− and dimerized (O 2 ) n− to a mixture of (O 2 ) n− and molecular O 2 . The intermediate oxygen species increasingly stabilize as molecular O 2 instead of (O 2 ) n− , a process coupled with the expansion of Li‐vacancy clusters and the growth of Mn‐enriched domains. We further demonstrate the same trend in the P3 analogue, which features a more stable ribbon superstructure with a topological “− α − γ −” stacking pattern (“− α − β −” for P2‐Na 0.6 Li 0.2 Mn 0.8 O 2 ), further corroborating that molecular O 2 formation is inescapable even when Mn migration is restricted in the pristine structure. Collectively, our results provide direct evidence that electron holes on O 2− are unstable upon cycling and identify molecular O 2 as the ultimate oxygen‐redox product for cathode oxides with nominally stable superstructure.
papers.summary_ko: P2형 Na0.6Li0.2Mn0.8O2 층상 산화물에서 충전 말기에 생성되는 산화 산소종이 사이클이 진행됨에 따라 O2−의 전자 홀과 이량체화된 (O2)n−의 혼합물에서 (O2)n−와 분자 O2의 혼합물로 연속적으로 변화함을 직접 규명했다. 이 과정은 Li-공공 클러스터의 확장과 Mn 풍부 영역의 성장과 동반되며, 더 안정한 리본 초구조를 갖는 P3 유사체에서도 동일한 경향이 관찰되어 안정적 초구조를 가진 양극 산화물에서도 분자 O2 형성이 음이온 레독스의 궁극적 산물임을 보였다.

papers.title: Autoantibodies associate with clinical outcome in patients with melanoma treated with a dendritic cell-based vaccine
papers.abstract_en: Increased B cell receptor signaling pathways in patients with melanoma correlates with a favorable clinical response to a cancer vaccine expressing multiple tumor-associated antigens. Here, we utilize phage immunoprecipitation sequencing (PhIP-seq) and Rapid Extracellular Antigen Profiling (REAP) assays to analyze the autoantibody profiles of patients with melanoma from a dendritic cell vaccine trial (NCT01622933), before and after vaccination. Patients have significantly elevated breadth and titer of autoantibodies compared to healthy donors. Vaccination results in the induction of de novo autoantibodies, particularly those with a favorable clinical outcome. Reduced serum SDF1-alpha, MIP-1ß, MCP1 and increased circulating monocytes are associated with development of autoantibodies. We identify plasma autoantibody signatures separating melanoma from healthy subjects as well as clinical responders vs non-responders to vaccination treatment. These findings demonstrate the potential for autoantibodies as diagnostic and prognostic biomarkers that predict clinical outcomes in cancer. NCT01622933 was a clinical trial of an autologous dendritic cell-based vaccine in patients with melanoma. Here the authors show that the vaccine results in the induction of de novo autoantibodies associated with a favourable clinical outcome.

papers.title: Ultra‐Long Helical CNFs 3D‐Networks as High‐Conductivity Current Collectors for Efficient Sodium Deposition
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Aluminum (Al) current collectors are crucial for sodium metal batteries (SMBs), yet sodium (Na) dendrite suppression and uniform Na deposition remain challenges. Surface modification could significantly optimize Na deposition behavior. Herein, a 20 nm copper (Cu) layer is designed to confine NiY diatomic catalyst (DAC) for Al surface modification via magnetron sputtering and heat treatment. The adjacent NiY atoms, with low single‐point energy (–228.05 eV), minimum segregation energy (−0.67 eV), and maximum aggregation energy (5.84 eV), synergistically stabilize diatomic dispersion in the Cu nanolayer. Benefiting from the tailored acetylene adsorption energy (−1.16 eV) and favorable formation energies of C 2 H (−13.58 eV) and C 2 (−11.44 eV), NiY–DAC exhibits excellent catalytic activity, in‐situ growth ultra‐long helical CNFs 3D‐networks with a thickness of 46.3 µm on Al current collectors, enabling efficient Na storage and remarkable inhibition Na dendrite formation. The modified current collector delivers outstanding electrochemical performance. The coulombic efficiency is up to 99.49% over 3000 h of half‐cells at 1.0 mA cm −2 /1.0 mAh cm −2 with a low overpotential (3.1 mV), and the CNFs‐Na||Na 3 V 2 (PO 4 ) 3 full‐cells achieve stable cycling over 1500 cycles at 10.0 C. This diatomic catalyst confinement strategy provides new insight into designing high‐performance carbon‐modified current collectors.

papers.title: Stabilizing Oxygen Redox via Li Dopants Into P2‐Type Cathodes for High‐Voltage Sodium‐Ion Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Anionic redox offers a pathway to increase the energy density of layered cathodes for sodium‐ion batteries, yet it is often accompanied by structure and interface degradation. Here, we demonstrate that Li dopants as regulators for oxygen redox in P2‐Na 0.67 Ni 0.33 Mn 0.67 O 2 through tuning local coordination environments and charge compensation pathways. Li dopants enhance Ni redox activity while moderating transition metal‐oxygen (TM‐O) coupling at high voltages. The online electrochemical mass spectrometry with 18 O isotope labeling reveals that it suppresses the lattice oxygen participation in electrolyte decomposition and mitigates irreversible oxygen loss. As a result, the Li‐doped Na 0.67 Li 0.2 Ni 0.23 Mn 0.67 O 2 exhibits improved rate capability cycling stability, delivering an initial capacity of 116.6 mAh/g with 80% retention after 400 cycles at 1 C, compared to 27% for the undoped counterpart. This work highlights the importance of controlling reactive oxygen species and establishes a strategy to stabilize high‐voltage operation by decoupling oxygen redox from degradation pathways in sodium‐ion cathodes.

papers.title: Post‐Synthetic Cerium Modification of Commercial NCM811 for Concurrent Cycling and Safety Upgrading
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT The widespread use of Ni‐rich LiNi 0.8 Co 0.1 Mn 0.1 O 2 (NCM811) cathodes in high‐energy batteries remains limited by structural degradation, side reactions, and oxygen release, yet most modification strategies prove incompatible with commercial materials. This work presents a facile solid‐state method that achieves synergistic cerium ion (Ce 3+ ) doping and CeO 2 coating on commercial NCM811 by mixing with CeO 2 nanoparticles followed by calcination. Structural and morphological analyses confirm Ce incorporation into the near‐surface lattice and the formation of a nanoscale CeO 2 layer without disturbing the layered framework. Electrochemical tests demonstrate that the optimal 1 wt.% Ce‐modified sample exhibits superior rate capability and long‐term stability, retaining 82.04% of its initial capacity after 500 cycles at 1 C, compared to 74.10% for pristine, owing to suppressed cation mixing, enhanced structural stability, and improved Li + diffusion kinetics. Crucially, differential electrochemical mass spectrometry shows Ce modification curtails O 2 release and reduces H 2 and CO 2 generation across various rates, effectively mitigating gas evolution associated with safety degradation. Accelerating rate calorimetry further confirms delayed thermal runaway and improved adiabatic stability. Overall, this work establishes a scalable post‐treatment route to simultaneously boost the electrochemical performance and safety of commercial nickel‐rich cathodes, offering a practical solution for next‐generation lithium‐ion batteries.

papers.title: Zwitterionic Thermoplastic Polyurethane‐Based Quasi‐Solid Polymer Electrolytes for Lithium Metal Batteries With Machine‐Learning‐Assisted Mechanistic Insights
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT This study presents a quasi‐solid‐state electrolyte based on zwitterionic thermoplastic polyurethane (QS‐Z‐TPU) for lithium metal batteries. Unlike conventional quasi‐solid polymer electrolytes that mainly serve as passive liquid‐electrolyte reservoirs, QS‐Z‐TPU is designed as an active ion‐regulating matrix via phosphorylcholine‐derived zwitterionic groups in the TPU framework. The resulting electrolyte combines the elasticity and film‐forming capability of TPU with dual‐site ion regulation, where phosphate sites coordinate Li + while quaternary ammonium and urethane N‐H groups immobilize TFSI − anions. This design enhances electrolyte affinity while suppressing destructive swelling due to ionic crosslinking. QS‐Z‐TPU exhibits high ionic conductivity, a wide electrochemical stability window, and an enhanced Li + transference number. Machine‐learning‐assisted molecular modeling further reveals that the zwitterionic oligomer stabilizes separated LiTFSI configurations through cooperative Li + coordination and TFSI − association, substantially reducing the energetic penalty for ion‐pair separation. This regulated ion environment promotes uniform Li + flux at the lithium metal interface and facilitates the formation of a stable inorganic‐rich solid electrolyte interphase. Consequently, QS‐Z‐TPU enables stable Li plating/stripping and improves the cycling stability and rate capability of LFP|Li full cells, further validated in flexible pouch‐cell demonstrations. These findings highlight zwitterionic molecular engineering as an effective strategy for interface‐stabilizing quasi‐solid electrolytes.

papers.title: Techno-economic and environmental assessment of next-generation battery-powered farming robots
papers.abstract_en: Abstract Decarbonizing agriculture without compromising productivity is a major challenge under rising input costs and labor scarcity. Autonomous battery-powered agricultural robots (ABARs) could help by reducing dependence on conventional machinery and enabling more precise application of inputs, but their system-level economic and environmental performance remains unclear. Here, we integrate total cost of ownership and life cycle assessment to evaluate a small ABAR for cradle-to-farm-gate crop production of strawberries, onions, lettuce, and peanuts under organic and non-organic management. Across modeled scenarios, benchmarked costs range from 76% below to 17% above literature-based reference ranges, while greenhouse-gas emissions fall within or below reported ranges. Variable inputs dominate both outcomes, contributing 72–90% of costs and 72–95% of global-warming impacts, with seeds, fertilizers, and irrigation water as main drivers. These results suggest that ABAR value depends less on the platform than on the ability of autonomous operation to reduce input use and labor demand.
papers.summary_ko: 배터리 구동 농업 로봇(ABAR)의 전과정평가(LCA)와 총소유비용(TCO)을 통합 분석하여 딸기, 양파, 양상추, 땅콩 재배에서의 경제성과 환경성을 평가했다. 비용과 온실가스 배출 모두 비료, 종자, 관개수 등 가변 투입재가 72~95%를 차지하는 주요 요인으로 나타났다. 자율주행 로봇의 가치는 플랫폼 자체보다 투입재와 노동력 절감 능력에 더 좌우된다는 결론을 제시했다.

papers.title: Solvent Toughened Glass Gel Electrolyte for High‐Voltage Lithium Metal Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT In situ polymerization electrolytes hold great promise for high‐energy‐density lithium‐metal batteries but often require additional separators due to their limited mechanical strength. Here, inspired by “glassy gels”, we developed a free‐standing glass gel electrolyte by introducing tributylmethylphosphonium dimethyl phosphate ([P 4441 ] [DMP]) into a poly(acrylic acid) (PAA) matrix. Strong non‐covalent interactions between [P 4441 ] [DMP] and PAA chains generate a tough and homogeneous network while enabling efficient ion transport. The resulting glass gel electrolyte exhibits an ionic conductivity of 2.2 mS cm −1 , a Li + transference number of 0.59, a tensile strength of 30 MPa, and an elongation of up to 700%. The solvent‐toughened scaffold effectively confines the liquid electrolyte and mitigates parasitic reactions with Li metal. Consequently, Li||Li symmetric cells achieve stable cycling for 1900 h at 3 mA cm −2 with an areal capacity of 3 mAh cm −2 . Li//NCM811 cells retain 90% of their capacity after 420 cycles, while Li//LiCoO 2 cells exhibit stable cycling for over 290 cycles at 1 C with a cutoff voltage of 4.6 V. This work provides a robust strategy for designing free‐standing electrolytes for high‐energy‐density lithium‐metal batteries.

papers.title: N‐Heterocyclic Molecular Additives Enable Solvation and Interfacial Chemistry Regulation for High‐Stability, High‐Rate, and High‐Capacity Lithium Metal Anodes
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Most electrolyte additives enable long‐term Li plating/stripping at <3 mA cm − 2 , non‐applicable to practical Li‐metal batteries (LMBs) operating at ≥5 mA cm − 2 and ≥ 5 mAh cm − 2 . Here, we report an interaction chemistry that enables simultaneous solvation and interfacial regulation by exploring a novel N‐heterocyclic molecule (i.e., TPTC)—comprising an N‐heterocyclic core and four pyridine units–as an efficient additive for achieving ultra‐stable Li‐metal anodes under practical conditions. Electron‐rich N atoms in TPTC serve as ion‐dipole interaction sites, inducing competitive coordination that weakens Li + solvation and enhances Li + migration in the bulk electrolyte, which homogenizes Li + concentration near the interface, favoring high‐rate Li deposition. TPTC also adsorbs on Li surface to construct a protective layer with a low interfacial de‐solvation barrier, which–together with low‐barrier Li + transport through heterocyclic cavities–facilitates uniform Li deposition. Meanwhile, electron‐deficient C–H sites in pyridine weakly interact with TFSI − , forming an anion‐rich interfacial region that in situ decomposes into an inorganic‐rich interphase, affording high‐flux Li + transport. This synergy allows stable Li plating/stripping at 10 mA cm −2 /10 mAh cm −2 for 3000 h. Paired with a high‐loading LiFePO 4 cathode (∼15 mg cm −2 ) and thin Li (∼100 µm), the cell maintains 87.8% capacity after 400 cycles.

papers.title: Liquid Metal Spheres Achieving Stable Residual SEI for Dendrite‐Free Lithium Metal Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Lithium dendrite growth represents the primary factor hindering the commercialization of high‐energy‐density lithium metal batteries, as it gives rise to safety hazards and low Coulombic efficiency. Surface morphology of deposited lithium is particularly affected by solid electrolyte interphase (SEI) and current collectors. Herein, we propose a current collector coated by spherical GaIn liquid metal nanoparticles encapsulated in a carbon layer (GaIn@C), which are spontaneously formed by the physical properties of liquid metal. This three‐dimensional spherical GaIn@C layer shows remarkable structure stability and avoids the tip effect during deposition of lithium, thus maintaining a stable residual SEI (rSEI) and dendrite‐free morphology over the repeated plating/stripping processes. The dendrite‐free lithium deposition behavior on GaIn@C layer was revealed via multiphysics simulation, ex‐situ deposition observation, in situ optical experiments, and in situ impedance analysis. Uniform deposition process of lithium half‐cell achieves a cycle life of up to 3500 h at an areal deposition capacity of 5 mAh cm −2 . Anode‐free full cell maintains specific capacity of 172.9 mAh g −1 after 100 cycles at 1C, with capacity retention of 99.9% and energy density of pouch battery exceed 410 Wh kg −1 . This study presents a general synthetic strategy for the construction of a current collector with stable residual SEI in dendrite‐free lithium metal batteries.
